title: Is Smack Studio Good
author: Lost_Suggestion_2436
selftext:
I used ai to generate a tribes man and then downscaled him to 64x64 and it looks really good. I am animating it in smack studio and it looks promising. I am bad at coding so I am using Gdevelop to make my first game.

 I just want a 2d game where a guy runs around killing monsters and can craft gear from them.

When I tried importing the sprite I made in smack studio to Gdevelop it puts a whole sprite sheet in there. I am really not sure how to split it up properly.

I tried looking for tutorials of people using Smack studio to make sprites for other games but I can't find anything. Am I just wasting my time with Smack Studio?

 If anyone knows of any tutorials for what I'm looking for any information would be greatly appreciated. Thanks for reading
